forms: se + 3rd person singular: Se trabaja mucho.
A thing — se + agreement: Se venden pisos.
A person as object: Se busca a los culpables.
Other ways: uno, la gente, ellos

examples.translation: In Spain people have dinner late.
You can't smoke here.

examples.text: Dicen que mañana va a llover.
examples.translation: They say it is going to rain tomorrow.

mistakes.note: The impersonal se takes a verb in the singular.
Before a direct object that is a person the preposition a is needed.

forms: ser = quality; estar = state, impression, result
guapo, listo, aburrido, verde, bueno change meaning
Result: está roto, está terminado
estar de + state: estar de vacaciones, de mal humor

examples.translation: My neighbour is very boring.

examples.text: Hoy estoy aburrido en el trabajo.
examples.translation: Today I am bored at work.
This soup is delicious.

mistakes.note: A permanent trait of character needs ser, not estar.
An unripe apple is estar verde, not ser verde.

forms: lo + adjective: lo bueno, lo importante
lo que: What… Lo que dices
lo + adj. + que: lo difícil que es
lo de + noun / inf.: lo de ayer

examples.translation: The important thing is not to give up.

examples.text: Lo que dices no tiene sentido.
examples.translation: What you say makes no sense.

examples.text: No te imaginas lo cansado que estoy.
examples.translation: You can't imagine how tired I am.

mistakes.note: For a general idea you need lo, not el.

mistakes.wrong: Lo que dices es lo mismos.
mistakes.right: Lo que dices es lo mismo.
mistakes.note: Lo does not change for number.
